findings.text: Local datetime types (LocalDatetime, LocalDate, LocalTime) are converted to UTC before formatting with v.In(time.UTC).Format(format), which shifts the time values. For example, a local datetime '2023-06-15T12:00:00' in UTC-5 would incorrectly encode as '2023-06-15T17:00:00' instead of preserving the original local time. Local times should be formatted without timezone conversion.
